newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico's Argos sees bottling investments.
newsitem.headline: Mexico's Argos sees bottling investments.

text.p: Mexican bottler Sistema Argos SA estimates its investments in 1997 will total 186 million pesos, Argos CFO Armando Martinez Celis said Tuesday.
"Of the investment, around 140-150 million pesos will be in the bottling division," Martinez Celis said.
He added one of the main projects will be a water treatment plant. Other investmnets will be in distribution equipment, Martinez Celis said.
((--Tomas de la Rosa, Mexico City newsroom +525 728 7912))
